what: Derived payloads that are published with the site but not committed to the repository.
why: scripts/check_repo_size.py caps the tracked tree at 60 MB and says, when that trips, the fix is to stop committing derived payloads rather than to raise the ceiling — they are reproducible from the pipeline, so they belong in a release asset fetched at build time. This file is that list. Each entry names the release it comes from and the checksum it must have, so a commit fetches exactly the payload it was built against rather than whatever the tag points at today.
howToAdd: Build the file, then `uv run python scripts/publish_release_data.py --id <id>` to upload it and rewrite this manifest with the size and checksum of exactly what was uploaded. Commit the manifest. The deploy fetches by checksum, so a manifest that is not committed means the site keeps the previous payload.

assets.what: Signed maxspeed per road portion over 76 653 km of motorway to tertiary, dissolved by value.
assets.withoutIt: The transport map's speed-limit toggle disables itself and says why; nothing else changes and no build fails.

assets.what: Motorway, trunk and primary roads, dissolved by class and simplified to 300 m — map context for the administrative and transport maps.
assets.withoutIt: The administrative map's road toggle disables itself and says so; the transport map's road toggles likewise. No build fails.

assets.what: Secondary and tertiary roads, simplified to 150 m — the network the model routes most of its distances over.
assets.withoutIt: The administrative map's road toggle disables itself and says so; the transport map's road toggles likewise. No build fails.

assets.what: The routed geometry behind each adjacency edge's distance, one GeoJSON per county — 7 874 of 7 932 intra-county edges, the remaining 58 being water borders no road crosses. Built from the same OSM extract as road_distance.parquet, so every reconstructed route reproduces the distance the model measured. Sharded so hovering a commune fetches its county and nothing else. The first asset here that is a directory, hence extractTo.
assets.withoutIt: The administrative map still draws the route a commune was absorbed along, but every leg is schematic: a dashed straight line between seats, carrying the real distance and captioned to say the line is not the road. Nothing fails.

assets.what: The generated August 20, 2026 Romanian public pay draft regime: reference value 4,000 lei and 1,061 positions.
assets.withoutIt: The salary simulator cannot load the August draft; CI and deploy fetch it before validation and build.
